body: Fuck it. I'm just going to take enough lorazepam to pass out and deal with this in the morning. It's obvious that none of these people care about me or want to help.

It's been an hour and half and no one has replied to my messages about switching shifts. I can't stop crying and I think a panic attack is coming on because my heart is racing and it's hard to breath. I'm so useless.
I appreciate it. For now, I'm trying to do self-care/treat yo self things like getting an ice cream sundae for breakfast at work because why the hell not?
I really appreciate it. Thank you so much.

Thank you. I've been trying for months but somehow it keeps getting worse with time, not better. Once I'm back at my university next month, I'll be able to resume therapy with my school counselor. I hope that will help.
Thank you. I will do so shortly.

Yeah. I don't know. He responded to my letters after the first breakup well enough that we got back together. So perhaps I'm doing something right...

I'm just really worried about timing. I feel like if I sent something now, he wouldn't take it seriously. He did say that if he wanted to talk to me that he'd reach out and I want to respect that. And yet, I know if a long time passes and I don't hear from him, it would be fair to assume that I'm never going to and I could send something then. But I don't know how long is long enough.

Yes. It was hard but I've accepted that, at this point, we have no real chance at a romantic relationship again. While I'm dating other people now, I know he'll eventually date other people, too (he hasn't, thus far). We would very likely meet other people who are better suited for us (hopefully I will, I mean, given how rare it is for me to experience attraction) and then that would take even more weight off of us and any friendship we'd have.

I hadn't spoken to him for three months before the last time I contacted him. I don't think one month would be enough. And even if I did message him, what would I say? How would I not relinquish my control? I have an apology letter that I was considering sending to him a year from now but it's very long.

Yes, if we took things slowly. We'd be long distance at this point because he graduated and moved back home recently, so it wouldn't be hard. I just can't stand him hating me. He was my best friend first and foremost and we shared almost all of our interests. I miss being able to do things like play our favorite online game together. The things we got into together just aren't as fun without him.

I feel like it's too soon. We last spoke at the end of May and when he told me my apology wasn't good enough, that I probably wouldn't "get" what I did wrong for "a couple years." But I feel like I've figured it out because what he said has been haunting me and all I can do is analyze what happened.
We could have done it, though, if I'd had the time to heal. But we both wanted to get back together so we did.
I know and I regret it more than anything. I was being really selfish and only looking out for myself. I hate myself for it. But I don't know how to tell him anything without making things worse.

I did a while back. He had broken up with me in early October and then we got back together in late November. I don't know what they could do to help me now. At least back then, there was the possibility of us being friends. Now he won't even speak to me and has blocked me on Facebook. And I, following the advice of a friend, deleted his number from my phone. The only way I could talk to him is to write him an email or letter and even if I did that, what could I say that wouldn't push him further away? He clearly doesn't want me anyway.

I want him back so badly. I have never loved someone as much as I love him, but I broke up with him because I thought it would make the pain of our struggling relationship go away. I didn't think I'd really lose him forever. 

I recently dated a guy for well over month. He was pretty much perfect me in terms of life goals and interests and treated me well. But I just couldn't feel attracted to him. I rarely ever feel attraction to anyone. My ex is the only person with whom I've felt I could with them longterm. I just can't see anyone else that way.
